\begin{document}
\large

Dear congregation,

Sometimes you want to drag people along.\\
Put on your shoes, eat your plate empty.

But everyone has a will of their own.\\
And then: trouble.

---\\
Then he says something hard to swallow.\\
\q{Do you also want to leave?}

%> note: prodigal son as second lens
\textbf{The open door}
The father lets him go.\\
He does not let him loose.

\textbf{The elder brother}
Faithful, but without heart.

---\\
Where else would I go?\\
Amen

\end{document}

loose thought: two pitfalls, faithfulness without heart, heart without faithfulness
